name: progressive-image
title: Progressive image
description: An image that arrives gracefully: a blurred placeholder in the right shape, a fade to the sharp picture, and a Retry button if it fails.
docs: Give it src and alt, and either ratio or the file's width and height, so the space is reserved before anything loads. blurDataURL (a tiny picture) or placeholderColor paints under the image until it has decoded; an image that was already there, from the cache or the server's HTML, shows without the fade. If it fails to load you get a quiet placeholder with the alt text and Retry; onRetry lets you swap the address. priority loads at once with a high fetch priority, fit is cover or contain, and src may be left out while the address is still unknown. With asChild it wraps your own element, such as a next/image with fill, and gives it the same behaviour.
